cohort: The cohort consisted of 45 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) and 45 control subjects matched for age, parity, and gestational age.
finding: Maternal serum IL-6 levels were significantly higher in women with PPROM compared to controls, and among PPROM patients, only early neonatal deaths were statistically significantly worse in those with IL-6 levels ≥ 14 pg/ml.
followup_time: Till delivery and early neonatal period (duration unspecified)
